click.text: A single very short delicate wooden Thai ranat xylophone tap with a tiny warm bell sparkle, cute magical game UI button click. Instant crisp onset, gentle dry sound, short clean decay. No background ambience, no music, no voices, no silence before the sound.

open.text: A soft ascending pair of Thai khim dulcimer plucks with a faint airy shimmer, magical menu opening in a cozy Thai fantasy game. Immediate onset, clear delicate notes, restrained volume, short decay. Isolated interface sound, no ambient noise, no speech, no music bed.

purchase.text: A small cheerful coin clink followed by two delicate Thai ranat wooden xylophone notes ascending, successful purchase in a cute magical village shop. Immediate onset, subtle and warm, quick clean decay, isolated game UI confirmation. No voice, no background ambience or music.

summon.text: A short magical spirit-summoning reveal: shimmering ascending khim hammered dulcimer notes with a gentle bamboo flute breath and one warm bell resolution. Cute Thai folklore game reward reveal, enchanting and delicate, immediate onset, soft tail. No loud impact, no speech, no singing, no background ambience, no long musical passage.
